audit_items.proof_trace: The RLS policy `using(true)` on `attendance.users` exposes every user's `card_id` to all authenticated users. `card_id` is the sole kiosk authentication credential — `attendance.record_attendance_by_card(p_card_id)` (SECURITY DEFINER) accepts only a `card_id` to record attendance with no additional secret, and EXECUTE is granted to `anon` (fix_security_permissions.sql:102). Proof fails: card_id IS a sensitive secret; its mass-exposure enables attendance impersonation by any authenticated (or unauthenticated) actor.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated user calls `SELECT supabase_auth_user_id, card_id FROM attendance.users` (permitted by the broad SELECT policy) to harvest all card_ids, then calls the publicly accessible Supabase RPC `attendance.record_attendance_by_card('<victim_card_id>')` as anon to forge or suppress arbitrary users' attendance records.
